summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Synaptra Studio's cinematic redesign. All features working correctly with the new Deep Obsidian Void theme and Precision Blue accents. Dashboard, Task Runner, and Eval pages render correctly. Navigation works across all sidebar links. Task creation and execution flow verified. No layout overlapping issues. GitHub link successfully removed from visible UI.

Dashboard: Recent Executions panel displays task history with scores
Dashboard: System status indicator shows OPERATIONAL state
Task Runner: Three-column layout (Task Queue, Main Workspace, Metrics) renders correctly
Task Runner: Task selection displays pipeline with 5 steps (Input Reception, Preprocessing, AI Analysis, Evaluation, Output Generation)
Task Runner: Pipeline shows completion status with timing for each step
Task Runner: Output panel displays analysis results correctly
Task Runner: Metrics panel shows Quality, Relevance, Efficiency, Plan Adherence scores with progress bars
Task Runner: Overall Score displayed prominently with heuristic composite description
Task Runner: Run Metadata shows Task ID, Created time, Model (gpt-5.2), Modality
Task Runner: New task creation and execution works correctly
Eval page: Three-column layout (Suites, Details, Run History) renders correctly

Eval page: Create Suite button present and functional

Design: Deep Obsidian Void background (#030303) applied correctly
Design: JetBrains Mono font used for data/labels
